prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and precise-object-edit.
Asset: revision of the fictional generic female cat avatar, with NO real person identity reference.
Input image is the existing generic female avatar to redesign. Keep the same warm textured gouache/colored-pencil series, real feline nose/muzzle/whiskers, fully clothed upper-bust framing and transparent background.
Primary request: make this deliberately MORE NEUTRAL and understated, a simple everyday default avatar rather than a glamorous personalized portrait.
Change: remove the long elaborate copper curls, dramatic lashes/eyeliner, sculpted arched brows and stylized beauty-portrait expression. Use simple short-to-medium soft light-brown hair/fur ending around the jaw with a natural uncomplicated side part, minimal volume and no styled curls. Give her a softly rounded balanced feline face, normal modest-sized brown eyes with fine natural lids and NO emphasized eyelashes, subtle straight brows, a relaxed neutral closed-mouth expression with only a very small friendly smile. Muted warm gray/taupe fur and soft cream muzzle, natural low-contrast coloring, no blush or makeup.
Clothing: ONE plain light beige/stone-gray crewneck knit sweater, modest high neckline, no cardigan layering, pink top, jewelry, decorative patterns or accessories. Simple everyday silhouette.
Keep: recognizable fictional female person-cat character, exactly TWO pointed CAT ears total on TOP, no lower human ears, delicate whiskers and true feline muzzle. Hand-painted gouache and pencil finish with soft tactile detail consistent with the series. She is not based on any real person.
Composition: centered frontal head-and-upper-torso bust on square canvas, calm straight pose, generous clear margins on ALL FOUR sides, complete ear tips with space above them, softly rounded shoulders.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no scenery, words, labels, circle badge, border, logo or watermark.
